entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 5,746 star（日均约 821，相对存量增速 4.4%），累计 130,612 star、8,312 fork。窗口内被 fork 463 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，468 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 5,746 stars over the last 7 days (~821/day, 4.4% of its base), now at 130,612 stars and 8,312 forks. 463 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 468 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一款 AI 编程助手，支持在桌面、移动端或云端运行 Claude Code、Codex 等多种编码代理。你可以在聊天或终端里与代理对话，甚至让它们并行完成大任务。
intro.en: Orca is an AI coding companion that lets you run Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents on desktop, mobile, or the cloud. Chat or use a terminal, and even orchestrate multiple agents to tackle big tasks in parallel.

cardLine.zh: 一站式 AI 编程助手，支持多代理并行、跨平台运行。
cardLine.en: All-in-one AI coding assistant that runs multiple agents in parallel across desktop, mobile, and cloud.

highlights.zh: 在聊天或终端里直接调用任何代理，保持上下文不丢失。
highlights.en: Invoke any agent in chat or terminal, preserving context across switches.

highlights.zh: 自动拆分大任务，启动工作树中的工作者代理，汇总结果。
highlights.en: Automatically split large tasks, start worker agents in isolated worktrees, and aggregate results.

highlights.zh: 支持远程服务器或云 VM，代理在你电脑休眠时仍保持运行。
highlights.en: Run on remote servers or cloud VMs so agents keep working even when your laptop sleeps.

highlights.zh: 移动 App 可随时收到代理通知，回复聊天保持进度。
highlights.en: Mobile app alerts you when an agent needs input, letting you keep work moving on the go.

cons.zh: 开放 issue 8,763 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 8,763 open issues — high relative to its star count

entries.quickstart:
# 摘自 stablyai/orca 的 README
# macOS (Homebrew)
# Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask.
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Upgrade an existing install
brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first)
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc

# Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source
yay -S stably-orca-bin

entries.name: daily_stock_analysis
entries.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,976 star（日均约 282，相对存量增速 2.7%），累计 73,540 star、57,988 fork。窗口内被 fork 766 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 109 个、issue 128 个，139 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,976 stars over the last 7 days (~282/day, 2.7% of its base), now at 73,540 stars and 57,988 forks. 766 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 109 PRs and 128 issues opened in the last 30 days; 139 contributors.

intro.zh: 这是一套基于 LLM 的股票分析系统，支持 A 股、港股、美股等多市场行情。每天自动抓取行情、新闻，生成决策报告并推送到企业微信、Telegram 等平台。
intro.en: An LLM‑powered stock analysis platform that pulls data from A‑share, Hong Kong, US, and other markets, automatically produces daily decision reports, and pushes them to channels like WeChat, Telegram, Slack, or email.

cardLine.zh: 多市场 LLM 股票分析系统，自动生成决策报告并推送。
cardLine.en: Multi‑market LLM stock analysis system that auto‑generates decision reports and pushes them.

highlights.zh: 支持 A 股、港股、美股、日股、韩股、台股及 ETF，覆盖行情、K 线、技术指标、新闻与公告。
highlights.en: Covers A‑share, Hong Kong, US, Japanese, Korean, Taiwanese stocks and ETFs, including market data, K‑lines, indicators, news, and announcements.

highlights.zh: 多轮对话 AI 策略问股，内置 15 种技术分析策略，支持 Web、Bot 与 API 调用。
highlights.en: Multi‑turn AI strategy querying with 15 built‑in technical analysis methods, usable via Web, bot, or API.

highlights.zh: 自动化部署：GitHub Actions、Docker、本地定时任务，支持企业微信/飞书/Telegram/Discord/Slack/邮件推送。
highlights.en: Automated deployment via GitHub Actions, Docker, or local cron, with pushes to WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and email.

highlights.zh: 零成本运行：默认使用免费行情源，亦可配置付费 Token 数据源，满足长期稳定分析需求。
highlights.en: Zero‑cost operation with free data sources by default, while allowing paid token‑based sources for long‑term stability.

cons.zh: 暂无独立文档系统（如 Wiki/Docs），查阅细节可能需通读 README
cons.en: No dedicated docs portal — onboarding relies primarily on README

fitFor.zh: 想给现有工作流加一层 Agent 自动化的团队
fitFor.en: Teams adding an agent-automation layer to an existing workflow

fitFor.zh: 偏工具链方向、重视可观测性的工程师
fitFor.en: Engineers on the tooling side who value observability

entries.quickstart:

git clone https://github.com/ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis.git && cd daily_stock_analysis

pip install -r requirements.txt

cp .env.example .env && vim .env

python main.py
